name: grok-skill-creator
title_zh: 从报错到打包一条龙，Grok 技能出厂前的质检台
tagline_zh: 写技能最怕触发不准、测了白测。它替你跑基准、查触发、验描述，还能直接打包成 .skill 文件，省掉来回试错的半天。
tagline_en: Skills that don't trigger are dead weight. This runs benchmarks, checks descriptions, verifies behavior, and.
desc_en: Create, test, and optimize Grok skills. Use when creating a skill from scratch, editing one, testing if a skill works, optimizing skill triggering, benchmarking performance, or packaging a .skill file. Triggers: "create skill", "new skill", "edit skill", "test skill", "skill not triggering", "optimize description", "package skill", "benchmark skill", "verify skill", "skill ready to ship", "skill q
why_zh: 把「测试」从玄学变成可重复的基准流程：每次改动都跑同一套验证，触发不准时能定位到描述里的具体措辞。
why_en: Turns 'does it work?' into a repeatable benchmark loop. Pinpoints trigger failures to specific wording in your description, so.
limit_zh: 只服务 Grok 平台的技能开发，不兼容 Claude/GPT 的 skill 格式；需要能联网跑基准测试的环境。
limit_en: Grok skills only—not for Claude/GPT formats. Needs network for benchmarking. Won't write your skill's logic, just create, test, optimize, and package.
title_en: A bench that tests, tunes, and packages your Grok skill
